messages:
jordan: Quick check — we're going to remove the legacy per-tenant fanout in favor of the compact credit events next week. Heads up for anyone relying on sidecar enrichment.
maria: +1 on the timeline, but we need a mitigation for late-arrival corrections. Compact events don't carry the old provenance blob.
sam: Can we include a minimal provenance pointer (fingerprint + origin_ts) in the compact event? That would let the audit pipeline join back to full records when needed.
nina: Fingerprint + origin_ts seems fine, but it means every compact event is now a join key. Perf hit on our streaming join? :thinking_face:
jordan: Right — tradeoff. Idea: include provenance pointer only for events flagged as "mutable" (refunds, charge corrections). Immutable usage stays tiny.
sam: That works. Implementation note: producer sets mutable=true for post-commit corrections. Downstream routing uses that to slow-path enrichment.
maria: Also need a graceful fallback in the reconciler: if provenance pointer doesn't resolve, mark for human review rather than auto-credit reversal.
nina: Agree. Add an observability metric: pointer_resolve_rate and a small gauge for unresolved pointers.
metering-bot: deploy:metering-compact-proto v2 -> staging succeeded :tada:
jordan: Nice. One more: what about schema evolution? compact event v2 adds pointer field. Consumers should default to ignoring unknown fields. We'll require consumers to opt into v2 via config flag for 2 weeks before toggling global.
sam: Suggest adding a quick consumer test harness in CI that runs compact_v1 and compact_v2 payloads against each consumer service.
maria: CI harness + opt-in rollout + pointer-only-for-mutable sounds like a safe path. I'll draft the rollout checklist and post in #eng-platform later today.
jordan: Thanks — if no objections by EOD we'll cut the prod change Wednesday midnight UTC. :thumbsup:
